summary: Nothing on this page is invented or misplaced: all 36 claims trace to the first panel or the red box, the priority level and and/or structure match the box heading, and every SNOMED concept exists. The only distortions are thresholds the language cannot carry: plain Hemoptysis fires on any blood rather than the page's '≥ 1 tablespoon of fresh blood' (c005/c028), 'Unable to walk' drops 'unaided' (c011/c034), and 'Unable to complete a sentence in one breath' is stricter than 'breathless while talking' (c003/c026). The possible-TB rule silently omits the asymptomatic test triggers for previous DS-TB and PLHIV, and the page's lower flowchart (urine LAM, INH-resistant TB and RR-TB diagnoses from NAAT/DST results) is not encoded at all, which a forward checker should weigh.
